notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat.
